{{Top}}
The '''Pastoral Collective''' was a group that maintained the meadows of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]]. Every spring, they helped to prepare the meadows for the [[Festival of Glad Arrival/Legends|Festival of Glad Arrival]].
